title: Pools and facilities planning
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-4 met: a rate is compared with a capacity only when the units agree and a non-matching unit is named rather than converted; a shortfall is reported as its own number; a planned facility is distinguishable from an operating one through the PPDM row and is excluded from the operational pages until it operates; and every pool and facility row carries the plan and plan version it belongs to.

dataModel.decision: PPDM owns the POOL and FACILITY identities and DevelopmentPlanning already owned FACILITY_INVESTMENT (FDP_ID, FIELD_ID, facility name/type, capacity + OUOM, CAPEX + currency, planned dates). DEV-04 therefore adds one planning table for the pool numbers and reuses the investment table for facilities, rather than duplicating either.
tables: DEVELOPMENT_POOL_PLAN (POOL_PLAN_ID key, FDP_ID, PLAN_VERSION, FIELD_ID, POOL_ID, POOL_NAME, RESERVOIR, DRIVE_MECHANISM, OOIP, OOIP_OUOM, RECOVERY_FACTOR, PLANNED_WELLS, FACILITY_ID, ACTOR, RECORDED_AT) - new, DevelopmentPlanning-owned; it carries only the plan's numbers and the facility routing, not the pool's PPDM identity
FACILITY_INVESTMENT - reused; gained PLAN_VERSION so a facility investment states the plan version it belongs to (AC-4), alongside the existing capacity, OUOM, CAPEX, currency and planned dates
dataModel.registration: DevelopmentPlanningModule registers DEVELOPMENT_POOL_PLAN; --smoke now reports 362 entity types (up from 361).
dataModel.rates: The plan's planned rate is the sum of DEVELOPMENT_WELL_SCHEDULE.INITIAL_RATE_OIL_BOPD (BOPD) and INITIAL_RATE_GAS_MMSCFD (MMSCFD); the unit is the column's own stated unit.

implementation.service: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Development/OgPoolsFacilities.cs (OgPoolPlan, OgFacilityPlan, OgCapacityLine, OgCapacityCheck, OgAllocationLine, OgAllocation, OgPoolsFacilitiesSnapshot, OgPoolValues, OgFacilityValues, IOgPoolsFacilities, OgPoolsFacilitiesService with ValidatePool/ValidateFacility/CheckCapacity/BuildAllocation/FacilityState/SavePoolAsync/SaveFacilityAsync)
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/PoolsFacilitiesPageView.cs (route 'poolsfacilities': pool grid and editor, facility grid and editor, capacity check panel, allocation preview)
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper (IOgPoolsFacilities), OgApplication.PoolsFacilities, catalog 'poolsfacilities' (OgModuleKeys.Development), OgPageFactory, en + ar labels; DEV-01's facility link now points at the real route
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/PoolsFacilitiesTests.cs (12, no database) + PoolsFacilitiesGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.database: SQLite with FIELD_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN, DEVELOPMENT_POOL_PLAN, FACILITY_INVESTMENT, DEVELOPMENT_WELL_SCHEDULE and the PPDM FACILITY table, seeded in PoolsFacilitiesGatewayTests
integration.ac4_plan_version: every pool row and every facility row reports PlanId FDP-1 and PlanVersion 3; the other field's plan, pool and facility are absent
integration.ac1_mixed_units: oil 1300 BOPD is compared only with the 1000 BOPD facility; the 'bbl/d' water plant and the MMSCFD gas plant are named as not comparable and are neither converted nor silently dropped
integration.ac2_shortfall: oil is short by 300 BOPD (1300 planned vs 1000 capacity) and the value is its own field; after a 500 BOPD planned facility is added the capacity becomes 1500 and the headroom 200
integration.ac3_states: F-1 is OPERATING (PPDM ACTIVE_IND='Y'), F-2 is IN_CONSTRUCTION (planned start passed, no PPDM row), F-4 is ABANDONED (PPDM ABANDONED_DATE) and a newly saved F-9 is PLANNED (start in the future); only F-1 is not excluded from the operational pages
integration.allocation: F-1 totals 45 MMbbl from two pools that share the unit; F-2 holds a Bcf pool and an MMstb pool, so it reports both units and no total; the unrouted pool is listed by name; a new 40 MMbbl x 0.25 pool routed to F-1 takes it to 55 MMbbl
integration.refusals: a pool with an OOIP and no unit is refused with pools-facilities-volume-unit-required; a pool routed to a facility outside the plan is refused with pools-facilities-facility-unknown; a facility with a capacity and no unit is refused with pools-facilities-capacity-unit-required
integration.failed_read: dropping FIELD_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN makes the load a failure with a reference and no snapshot, not an empty plan

gates.AC-1 Capacity and rate comparisons refus: pass - a rate in BOPD is summed only against facilities whose CAPACITY_OUOM is BOPD (and MMSCFD against MMSCFD); any other unit is listed as not comparable with its unit named. The allocation preview applies the same rule to volumes: two OOIP units produce no total.
gates.AC-2 A shortfall is shown as a number, n: pass - headroom is capacity - rate and the shortfall is its negation when negative; the gateway test reads 300 BOPD short and then 200 BOPD headroom after a facility is added.
gates.AC-3 A planned facility is distinguishab: pass - the state comes from the PPDM FACILITY row (operating/abandoned) and otherwise from the planned start date (planned/in construction); only an operating facility is not excluded from the operational pages, and planned dates alone never report 'operating'.
gates.AC-4 Pool and facility records link to t: pass - DEVELOPMENT_POOL_PLAN carries FDP_ID + PLAN_VERSION and FACILITY_INVESTMENT gained PLAN_VERSION; both are written from the plan row's FDP_VERSION and the workspace shows the plan version on both grids.

limits: The capacity check compares the plan's own planned rates with the plan's own planned capacity: it includes facilities that are in construction or planned and excludes only abandoned ones, so it is a planning check, not a today's-throughput check. The page shows each facility's state next to the number.

FACILITY_INVESTMENT's numeric column is named CAPACITY_PLANNED_BOPD but is read as 'capacity in CAPACITY_OUOM'; a row whose unit is MMSCFD therefore reports gas capacity. The mismatch between the column name and the unit column is a pre-existing table design that this feature does not rename.
No unit conversion is performed anywhere: 'bbl/d' is not treated as BOPD, and no gas-to-oil equivalence is invented.

The allocation preview sums recoverable volume (OOIP x recovery factor) per facility; it does not allocate by well, by time or by pipeline capacity, and it does not compare recoverable volume with facility throughput capacity (those are different quantities with different units).
Facility identity in the PPDM FACILITY table is matched by FACILITY_ID only; a plan facility with no PPDM facility id can never be operating.
The feature doc's per-command permissions (development.pools.write, development.facilities.write) are not enforced: the app gates pages, not commands.
The production pools page (PRD-02) is not built; whether it is the same records viewed differently is still the open question recorded in the feature doc.
The new table and the new FACILITY_INVESTMENT column need the DEVELOPMENT_PLANNING module applied again on an existing database.
